name: Claude
summary: Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, coding, analysis and long-document work — strong reasoning and a careful, direct tone rather than an eager-to-please one. Free tier plus Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, and a per-token API (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) for builders.
best_for: developers, writers, analysts and researchers who want best-in-class reasoning, coding and long-document work — and a model that's careful and direct rather than eager to please
skip_if: you mainly need image generation or the widest third-party plugin ecosystem (a general assistant like ChatGPT fits better there), or you're a light user the free tier already covers
honest_knock: The honest catch is usage limits: even on Pro you can hit a ceiling mid-session on a heavy day, and the step up to Max is a real $100 to $200 a month — you're buying headroom, not extra features. It also doesn't generate images, so if that's your main need it's the wrong tool, and its third-party plugin ecosystem is smaller than ChatGPT's.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month billed annually ($200 upfront), or $20 a month billed monthly
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-10-11 on their own pricing page; unchanged since 2026-08-27) The free tier is $0. Pro is $17/month with the annual discount ($200 billed up front) or $20 billed monthly, and includes Claude Code and unlimited projects. Max starts at $100/month for 5x or 20x the usage of Pro per five-hour session, and now also lists $100 (Max 5x) or $200 (Max 20x) a month in API credits for building on the Claude Platform. Team is for teams of 2 to 150: a standard seat is $20/seat/month billed annually ($25 monthly), and a premium seat is $100/seat/month billed annually ($125 monthly) for 5x the usage of a standard seat, adding Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Enterprise self-serve is $20/seat plus usage billed at API rates, so cost scales with the models and tasks the team runs; larger contracts are custom via sales. The API is separate and billed per token across the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku models, with platform features priced on top: Managed Agents at $0.08 per session-hour of active runtime, web search at $10 per 1,000 searches, and code execution beyond the 50 free hours a day at $0.05 per hour per container.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 23 October 2026 on Daan's existing claude.ai account on the Max plan, not the Free plan, with the model set to Opus 5.5: our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. Conflict of interest: AIBuilder Marketplace uses Claude itself for research and writing. This was a small faithfulness test on a short text file, not a comparison with other assistants.
findings: We uploaded a short text file containing three contract records (A, B and C with seats and renewal dates) and a stated total ('Total seats 12.') and asked three questions with the instruction to quote the exact source text. All three answers were right, each with the literal source sentence: 12 seats in total (with the check 3 + 7 + 2 = 12), only contract A renewing before 2027, and contract C's renewal 'unknown'.
The trap question, which vendor supplies contract B, got 'unknown' with the remark that the file does not name a vendor for any contract. No name was made up.
Unprompted, it added that contract C might also renew before 2027, but that the file does not let it confirm that.
A second run in a new chat with the same file and question gave the same four answers and quotes, in a different layout (a numbered list). On this small test the answers were reproducible.
We saw no usage-limit message or counter after two short runs, but on the Max plan that says nothing about the limits on Free.
Conflict of interest: AIBuilder Marketplace uses Claude for research and writing, including the assistant that ran this test. Weigh this hands-on note accordingly.
